rule_id: jevbench_guard/v2: JevBench public items (pinned) as an eval-only doc-overlap source + fingerprint; instruction / option segments shared by >= 2 items are templates (not indexed by the fingerprint, never an exact hit); the scan's exact-segment gate uses item segments of >= 6 words

doc_index.rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams, (E)/(U) units >= 5 grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%, or both df >= 10, or eval df >= 100 (templates), excluded from instruction/option units only, never from state units; allowlist entries never apply to rows of the eval family own source; R denominator drops allowlisted grams, R needs >= 3 covered; reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
